events_lede: Talks, tastings, exhibitions and workshops. Every event needs registration, so we know how many to expect.
events_empty: No events coming up. Check back soon.
events_sent: Thank you, you are registered. We will confirm by phone or email.
events_err_closed: Registration for this event is closed
events_err_full: Not enough places are left for that many
events_members_note: This event is for members of the museum. Call us or ask at the front desk to register.
exp_lede: Walk the halls with a guide, sit down to a coffee ceremony, or taste this season's lots with our Q-grader.
exp_ticket_plus: on top of the entry ticket
exp_no_sessions: No times are open right now. Send a request and we will find one.
exp_sent: Thank you! We have your request and will confirm by phone or email within a day.
exp_err_room: Only {count} places are left at that time
exp_request_lede: Send your request. We confirm by phone or email, then take payment.
exp_groups_note: Private events and school visits are booked by request.
exp_empty: No experiences are open for booking right now.
site_consent: Send me news about events and new coffees. (Optional; you can stop any time.)
contact_lede: Ask us anything about the museum, the coffee or a visit, or tell us how your visit went. We answer within one working day.
contact_tabs_label: What would you like to send?
contact_reach_hint: Give us an email or a phone number, so we can answer you.
contact_err_reach: Give an email or a phone number
contact_thanks_enquiry: Thank you. Your message is with our team, and we will answer within one working day.
contact_thanks_feedback: Thank you for your feedback. It helps us make the museum better.
contact_address_value: Kebena Museum, the coffee cup building, Jimma, Oromia, Ethiopia
groups_lede: Schools and groups of 10 or more book by request. Tell us when you would like to come, and we will confirm a date and send an invoice.
groups_step_1: Send the request below with up to three dates that suit you.
groups_step_2: We confirm a date and time slot, which holds your places, and send an invoice.
groups_step_3: Once paid, you get one group QR code for the entrance. Part of the group can check in at a time.
groups_kind_school_hint: Weekday mornings, up to 40 pupils per visit.
groups_kind_group_hint: Tour groups, companies, associations: 10 people or more.
groups_tin_hint: For the invoice, if your organisation needs one with its TIN.
groups_requests_hint: Accessibility needs, a guided tour in Amharic or English, a coffee ceremony…
groups_thanks: Thank you. We have your request and will contact you to confirm a date.
groups_fact_capacity: Each time slot welcomes up to 50 visitors, so large groups may be split across slots.
groups_fact_payment: Pay by bank transfer against the invoice, or online with the payment link we send.
groups_fact_hold: We hold your places for 7 days while the invoice is unpaid.
groups_fact_qr: Your group gets one QR code with its headcount.
groups_event_lede: Hire the museum for a celebration, a company event or a coffee ceremony. Tell us what you have in mind and we will send a quote.
groups_event_type_placeholder: e.g. company dinner, wedding coffee ceremony
groups_event_thanks: Thank you. Our events team will contact you with a quote.
wholesale_lede: Roasted Kebena coffee for cafés, hotels, restaurants, offices and shops, at wholesale prices once your account is approved.
wholesale_how_apply_text: Send the application below with your trade licence and TIN. We check it and let you know by SMS or email, usually within two working days.
wholesale_how_minimum_text: Once approved, you see wholesale prices and order 1 kg bags, at least {kg} kg per order. Mixed coffees are fine.
wholesale_how_pay_text: Pay before delivery by Chapa or bank transfer. Credit terms can be agreed for regular customers.
wholesale_tiers_hint: Discount on the retail 1 kg price, before VAT.
wholesale_licence_file_hint: A photo or PDF. You can also bring it when we visit.
wholesale_address_hint: Sub-city, woreda, street and a landmark. You can add more addresses later.
wholesale_thanks: Thank you. Your application is with our team; we will let you know once it is approved.
wholesale_err_tin: A business with this TIN already has an account. Call us if you need access to it.
wholesale_quote_lede: Buying green coffee to export? Our export team quotes and sends samples. Tell us what you need.
wholesale_quote_thanks: Thank you. Our export team will send a quote.
member_lede: A year of free entry, member prices in the shop, free delivery in Addis and events only for members. Pick a plan, tell us who it is for, and pay online.
member_none: Memberships are not on sale online yet. Call us and we will set one up for you.
member_covers_family: Covers {adults} adults and up to {children} children
member_perk_entry: Free entry, any day we are open
member_phone_hint: Your membership is linked to this number.
member_people_hint: Write the names as they should appear on each card. You can add or change people later at the museum.
member_start_hint: Your membership runs from this day. If you pay later, it starts on the day you pay.
member_consent: Send me news about exhibitions, events and new coffees (you can stop any time).
member_pay_note: You pay on the next page. Your cards are ready once the payment is through.
member_thanks: Thank you. We have your request.
member_err_start: Choose a start date from today up to 90 days ahead
member_err_children: This plan covers up to {max} children
subs_lede: Fresh-roasted Kebena coffee every two weeks or every month. Pay for a bundle of deliveries up front and save; skip, pause or change your coffee whenever you like.
subs_none: Subscriptions are not open online yet. Call us and we will set one up for you.
subs_biweekly_hint: For a household that drinks a lot of coffee.
subs_landmark_hint: What the rider should look for: a building, a church, a shop.
subs_pickup_hint: You collect each bag from the museum shop when we tell you it is roasted.
subs_phone_hint: We call or text this number before each delivery.
subs_consent: Send me news about new coffees and offers (you can stop any time).
subs_pay_note: You pay for the whole bundle on the next page. Your first coffee is roasted on the next roast day after payment.
subs_thanks: Thank you. We have your request.
subs_err_roast: Choose a roast this coffee comes in
subs_err_grind: Choose a grind this coffee comes in
trace_lede: The farms, lots, roast and packing behind this bag of Kebena coffee.
trace_not_found: We could not find this bag. Check the code on the label.
trace_packed_story: Each bag is sealed the day it is packed and carries this page on its label, so you can see every step behind it.
trace_no_lots: The lots behind this bag have not been recorded yet.
shop_lede: Coffee from our own farms and washing stations in Jimma, roasted for you, plus a few things for the ceremony at home.
shop_empty: Nothing is on sale right now. Check back soon.
shop_not_found: We could not find that product.
shop_roast_note: Roasted to order: we roast it on the next roast day, then send it out fresh.
shop_add_invalid: That choice is not available. Pick again.

cart_invalid: That did not work. Try again.
cart_delivery_later: Delivery is worked out at checkout. Pickup at the museum is free.
cart_fix_short: Some items are short in stock. Lower the amounts to go on.
checkout_lede: No account needed. We use your phone number to tell you about your order.
checkout_phone_hint: We send order updates by SMS.
checkout_delivery_hint: Our riders in Addis Ababa, or a courier to other cities.
checkout_landmark_hint: Something the rider can find, like a church, school or shop.
checkout_courier_note: Outside Addis we send by courier; it takes about {days} extra working days. For heavy orders we will call you with a quote.
checkout_consent: Send me news about new coffees and museum events. You can stop any time.
checkout_pay_hint: You pay on Chapa's secure page: card, telebirr, CBE Birr or M-Pesa.
checkout_place_hint: We will call you to take payment before we send anything.
checkout_cart_changed: Your cart changed while you were checking out. Look it over and try again.
checkout_short: Not enough in stock for: {items}. Lower the amount in your cart.
